FROM "show_rollups"
JOIN "core" ON "show_rollups"."srkeys" = "core"."content_key"
JOIN "content_info" ON "core"."content_key" = "content_info"."content_key"
WHERE "content_info"."visualassets"->>'trailers' IS NULL
  AND "content_info"."visualassets"->>'clips' IS NULL
  AND "show_rollups"."ratinginfo"->>'user_score' IS NOT NULL

SELECT "srkeys" AS "show_id", CURRENT_DATE - MAX(CAST(COALESCE("latestadd", "launchmoment") AS DATE)) AS "days_stale"
FROM "show_rollups"
GROUP BY "srkeys"
ORDER BY "days_stale" DESC

WITH franchise_shows AS (
SELECT "core"."series_id" AS franchise_id, "show_rollups"."srkeys" AS show_id, "core"."content_title" AS show_title FROM "show_rollups" JOIN "core" ON "show_rollups"."srkeys" = "core"."content_key"
),
franchise_show_stats AS (
SELECT
    "series_id" AS franchise_id,
    COUNT(*) AS show_count,
    json_agg("content_title") AS show_titles
FROM "core"
GROUP BY "series_id"
)
SELECT franchise_id, show_count, show_titles
FROM franchise_show_stats
WHERE show_count >= 2
ORDER BY show_count DESC

WITH show_episode_stats AS (
SELECT
    "srkeys" AS "show_id",
    COUNT(*) AS "total_episodes",
    COUNT(DISTINCT "srlinks") AS "season_count"
FROM "show_rollups"
GROUP BY "srkeys"
)
SELECT 
    show_id, 
    total_episodes, 
    season_count, 
    total_episodes / season_count AS avg_episodes_per_season
FROM show_episode_stats
WHERE season_count IS NOT NULL AND season_count > 0
ORDER BY avg_episodes_per_season DESC

WITH show_maturity_records AS (
SELECT srkeys, srlinks, ratinginfo->>'maturity_rating' AS maturity_rating
FROM "show_rollups"
)
SELECT maturity_rating AS most_frequent_maturity_rating
FROM show_maturity_records
GROUP BY maturity_rating
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH episode_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    content_key,
    CASE 
      WHEN trim(mediacounts::text) ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN trim(mediacounts::text)::int 
      ELSE 0 
    END AS total_episodes
  FROM content_info
)
SELECT 
  c.series_id AS identifier,
  COUNT(e.content_key) AS num_shows,
  SUM(e.total_episodes) AS total_episodes
FROM episode_counts e
JOIN core c ON e.content_key = c.content_key
WHERE c.series_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.series_id
HAVING SUM(e.total_episodes) > 100
ORDER BY total_episodes DESC

WITH plan_title_counts AS (
SELECT
    r."tierkey" AS plan_id,
    r."tiertype" AS plan_name,
    COUNT(c."content_key") AS title_count
FROM "core" c
JOIN "show_rollups" sr ON c."content_key" = sr."srkeys"
JOIN "rollups" r ON sr."srlinks" = r."tierkey"
GROUP BY r."tierkey", r."tiertype"
)
SELECT 
    plan_name, 
    title_count, 
    (title_count * 100.0) / SUM(title_count) OVER () AS percentage
FROM plan_title_counts
ORDER BY percentage DESC
